mathematical_sources.title: Maximality of the Došen–Petrić Boolean Category, version 8
mathematical_sources.note: The manuscript is retained with the substantive Lean development. This is source-based formalization of the manuscript's result. Its v8 mathematical content is unchanged from v7. The selected declarations and the broader complete-paper correspondence are identified separately below.

mathematical_sources.title: Proof-Theoretical Coherence
mathematical_sources.location: King's College Publications, 2004; revised author version September 2007; the zero-identity Boolean presentation in Sections 14.2–14.3 and the cut-elimination and coherence arguments used by that presentation.
mathematical_sources.note: The development includes proofs of the cut-elimination and coherence inputs needed for the actual source category. It does not attribute the manuscript's maximality theorem to this book. Appendix C identifies two source rank corrections and gives their concrete formal correspondences.

mathematical_sources.title: Isomorphic formulae in classical propositional logic
mathematical_sources.location: Mathematical Logic Quarterly 58 (2012), 5–17; Lemma 7; author version arXiv:0912.1271v3.
mathematical_sources.note: The manuscript relates its particular q/e isomorphisms to the occurrence-bijection construction in Lemma 7. The actual arrows and their inverses are proved in the source category; no assumed isomorphism field replaces those constructions.
